s.note: Buttermilk cornbread baked in a hot pan.
s.how: Heat a greased 25cm pan in the oven at 210C. Mix 200g cornmeal, 125g flour, 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt with 350ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 80g melted butter. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes, then cut into squares and serve with butter.

s.note: Split peas simmered thick with a ham hock, ladled into tin bowls.
s.how: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a splash of oil in a big pot. Add the split peas, ham hock, bay leaves and water and bring to the boil. Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until the peas collapse and the soup is thick. Lift out the hock, pull the meat off the bone, shred it and stir it back in. Season and ladle into bowls.

m.note: Beef chuck, potatoes and carrots slow-cooked in rich stock.
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches, then soften 2 onions. Return the beef with 2 tbsp flour, 750ml beef stock, 600g potatoes and 3 carrots in chunks. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender. Ladle into bowls with thick white bread.

w.note: Milk chocolate with marshmallows, peanuts and broken cookies.
w.how: Melt 400g milk chocolate gently. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted peanuts and 100g broken plain biscuits. Spread into a lined 20cm tin, chill 2 hours until set and cut into rough rocks.

d.note: Ice-cold spicy ginger beer with fresh ginger coins and a squeeze of lime, in frosted glasses.
d.how: Ice-cold ginger beer with fresh lime and thin coins of ginger, poured into frosted glasses in the sun. Put 4 glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Slice a 3cm knob of ginger into thin coins and cut 2 limes into wedges. Fill each glass with 330ml cold ginger beer, squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins.
